description: Two-rate grid for a stored model: vary two transition rates over ranges, run each combination to the horizon with the continuous engine, and return the observable's final value as a grid — 'which regime of arrivals × restock keeps the queue empty'. Continuous reading: a model with a schedule or a gate is refused with the reason. Costs 1 token per 50 grid cells (rounded up; a 40x40 grid empties the bucket) from your account's compute bucket.

hours.description: horizon per run (default 8, above 0 and at most 10000)

log_scale.description: space the grid in log10 (default false)

observable.description: place id whose final value fills the grid

range_x.description: JSON [start, stop, n] for param_x: non-negative rates, n a whole number 2..40

range_y.description: JSON [start, stop, n] for param_y: non-negative rates, n a whole number 2..40

name: sim_param_heatmap
